quote.text:
I built Homebase — family mission control for school chaos.

It watches school email + portals + classroom apps, checks whether any parent already signed up (so you don’t double-book), puts missing dates on the shared family calendar, and only pings the family chat when something still needs action.

Grade-aware. Multi-guardian. Twice-daily sweeps. Zero “go check the app” nags.

Clone it → https://x.ai/bot/WZ7amxhH9gXXBEaGmg0un

Built for the Grok Bot Sharing Contest.
